messages:
maria_cs: FYI -- we just flagged a failure in the bulk onboarding pipeline that's prevented some Dedicated customers from completing initial data ingestion. Affected tenants: AcmeMetrics, Brightleaf, BlueCart. I want to draft a short customer-facing status + mitigation plan.

ben_platform: Thanks for the heads up. Is this still ongoing? any ETA on fix?

maria_cs: It's ongoing. Kai is looking at a dedupe/queueing regression that started after yesterday's deploy. We should notify impacted accounts within the hour. Proposed approach: 1) quick status email now explaining we're investigating + temporary workaround, 2) follow-up once root cause confirmed + ETA, 3) offer a one-time onboarding credit and prioritized re-run.

kai_eng: Root cause summary from infra: a change to webhook retry backoff caused duplicate job IDs to be dropped by the dedupe layer. Error logs show repeated "duplicate job id" entries and queue timeouts. Example: 
```
ERROR ingestion-queue: dropped job id=9f3a... duplicate detected (post-retry)
WARN dedupe-service: kv-lock timeout for job 9f3a... after 120s
```
We can roll back the change (safe) or patch dedupe logic to accept retried job ids. Rollback gives fastest recovery (~30-45m).

sam_ops: Rollback sounds good to me. If we rollback, we should capture exact time window of impacted jobs and prepare a re-ingest plan. Who will own customer comms?

maria_cs: I'll own initial comms and coordinate re-ingest scheduling with CS leads. Draft status below, please review for technical accuracy and tone: 

"Hi <customer>,
We're investigating an issue affecting bulk onboarding to Redwood Dedicated that may have prevented some of your data from ingesting. Our engineering team is actively rolling back a recent change to restore normal onboarding flows. We expect a recovery within the next 30-60 minutes.

What we're doing now:
- Rolling back the triggering deploy to restore ingest throughput.
- Identifying the exact jobs affected and offering an automated re-run.
- We'll follow up with a root cause summary and next steps.

What we recommend you do:
- No action required — we'll reach out if we need anything from you.

Compensation: We're offering a one-time onboarding credit and will prioritize your re-ingest.

Apologies for the disruption — we'll update within 1 hour with progress and a postmortem."

kai_eng: Content looks good. Suggest adding: "If you see any duplicate records in your UI, let us know; we have a de-dupe clean-up script."

ben_platform: Add runbook link and internal support contact so customers don't reply to an unattended mailbox. Also remove exact ETA in public comms? maybe say "shortly" instead of 30-60m to avoid mismatch.

maria_cs: Updated draft: 

"Hi <customer>,
We're investigating an issue affecting bulk onboarding to Redwood Dedicated that may have prevented some of your data from ingesting. Our engineering team is actively rolling back the recent change and we expect to restore normal onboarding shortly.

What we're doing now:
- Rolling back the triggering deploy to restore ingest throughput.
- Identifying impacted jobs and offering an automated re-run.
- Preparing a de-duplication script if duplicate records surface.
- Internal runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/bulk_onboard_incident

What we recommend you do:
- No action required. If you notice duplicate records or missing datasets, reply to this thread (cc: your CS lead) and we'll prioritize a fix.

Compensation: We're offering a one-time onboarding credit and prioritized re-ingest for affected tenants.

Apologies for the disruption — we'll update within 1 hour with progress and a postmortem."

sam_ops: LGTM. For enterprise customers (AcmeMetrics + Brightleaf) please also call the CSMs directly. I'll ping legal for the wording of credits.

incident-bot: [incident created] INC-2026-04: Bulk onboarding failure (Dedicated). Severity: P2. Link: https://incidents.redwood/internal/INC-2026-04

maria_cs: Action items: 
- ben_platform: coordinate rollback & ETA with infra (assigned)
- kai_eng: perform rollback and validate re-ingest path (assigned)
- sam_ops: notify CSMs and share instruction for phone outreach (assigned)
- maria_cs: send initial customer email to affected accounts within 30m and post follow-up in this thread (assigned)

ben_platform: On it, rolling back now. Will report back with validation logs. :rocket:

maria_cs: Thanks team. I'll post the outbound copy shortly and update customers once rollback validated. :thumbsup:
